event_daxia_teach.why: （使用者 09-24 晚：封封那張倒著看書，同一毛病）書頁正對我們、球球從書後面往下看＝倒著讀；球球還是舊版冷灰毛色
event_daxia_teach.scene: Qiuqiu sits on a low stone step on a small patch of cracked stone floor. In both paws he holds an old martial-arts manual with a frayed, worn dark-blue cover, open in front of his chest, and with one paw he is turning a page further on (the page mid-turn, bending over). He looks into the book with a curious, searching face. THE BOOK FACES ITS READER: the cat holds the open manual up in front of himself with the open pages turned TOWARD HIS OWN FACE, so from our side we see the worn dark-blue COVER on the outside of the book (and at most a thin sliver of page edge) - we do NOT see the pages' pictures or writing. Never draw the pages facing us while the cat looks at them from behind or from above - that would mean he is reading upside down. The book is held firmly in his paws, not floating.
refs: the SETTING of this event: the small patch of cracked grey stone floor in a stairwell - copy the place and the old worn dark-blue manual, but NOT the way the cat leans over a book lying flat.
